name: mergeset
title_zh: 同一仓库多分支并行，它帮你排出落地顺序
tagline_zh: 多分支同时在飞，谁先合、谁跟谁冲突、能不能一起落——它不光说结论，还讲清为什么，直接给你集成分支方案。
tagline_en: Several branches in flight? It tells you what merges cleanly, what conflicts and why, and hands you the.
desc_en: Work out which branches or pull requests can be merged together, and in what order. Use when several changes are in flight on one repository and someone asks which of them can land together, what conflicts with what and why, whether a set of branches can be merged, why two changes cannot go together, or for a landing plan and integration branches. Also use to read or explain an existing mergeset r
why_zh: 不是拍脑袋排序，而是基于真实提交图算冲突闭包，能解释任意两分支为何不能共存，并给出可执行的落地计划。
why_en: Computes conflict closure from the real commit graph, not guesses—explains why any pair clashes and yields a concrete landing.
limit_zh: 只针对同一仓库内的分支/PR 合并关系；不处理跨仓库依赖，不自动执行合并，也不评估测试或部署风险。
limit_en: Only for merge relations within one repo; no cross-repo deps, no auto-merging, no CI/deploy risk. Outputs order & integration branch.
title_en: Merge planner for parallel branches & PRs
